value.rationale: Q4 is a canonical sixteen-site periodic planar lattice with complete graph symmetry and a natural first nontrivial binary-hypercube extension of Q3. Its exact primitive-period census identifies 1344 ten-cycles and sharply distinguishes dimension four from 1–3; 10-cycle existence and abundance are not supplied by the earlier general survival theory. The basin decomposition (752256 states reach ten-cycles) and eleven-step sharp entry cutoff quantify dynamical relevance, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The result is a complete natural finite cutoff and does not assert a general theorem for d>=5.
